name: Long Beach historical AIS + NOAA ENC port-operations benchmark
description: Historical AIS route segments and traffic snapshots aligned with public model forcing and current NOAA ENC-derived research geometry.

port.name: Port of Long Beach research area
jurisdiction: Los Angeles-Long Beach Vessel Traffic Service

source.provider: NOAA OCM / BOEM / U.S. Coast Guard Marine Cadastre
source.license_note: Historical NAIS-derived public data for coastal/ocean planning; cite Marine Cadastre. The checked-in derivative is not a live feed.

enc.provider: NOAA Office of Coast Survey ENC Direct to GIS
enc.navigation_suitability: ENC Direct to GIS is not certified for navigation; official NOAA ENC and local notices are required for operational use

source.temporal_alignment_note: AIS and weather use 2025-01-01..07; ENC Direct to GIS reflects the retrieval-date chart derivative and may not match 2025 notices.

split_policy.identity_note: MMSI is excluded from observations. The same vessel may recur on later dates; temporal isolation measures future-day generalization.

sources.name: 2026 Port of Los Angeles Mariners Guide for the San Pedro Bay complex
Jacobsen Pilot Service, Port of Long Beach

modelled.colreg_encounter_context: conservative give-way proxy; not a COLREG compliance engine
